assumptions: One scalar Gaussian parameter with prior variance one
Two observations with positive independent noise variance one
Two shared scalar source blocks, each with known marginal variance one
Unknown cross-source correlation is restricted to the declared closed interval
Source Jacobians and observation sensitivities are fixed and known
The two-source covariance is positive semidefinite for every correlation in [-1,1]
non_claims: The fixture does not establish a physical source-correlation interval
No detector or nuclear-data observations are represented
The correlation interval itself requires an evidence-backed receipt for a qualified scientific decision
The module is limited to two observations, two shared scalar sources and one scalar parameter
No general multivariate partial-identification or SOTA superiority claim is made
